newsitem.title: USA: Chubb to sell life insurance unit for $875 million.
newsitem.headline: Chubb to sell life insurance unit for $875 million.

text.p: Chubb Corp on Monday announced it had signed a definitive agreement to sell its Chubb Life Insurance Co of America unit to Jefferson-Pilot Corp for $875 million in cash.
Chubb chairman and chief executive officer Dean O'Hare said the company intends to use a substantial portion of the proceeds of the sale to buy back Chubb stock.

O'Hare said Chubb Life management has "done a terrific job turning the company around in the last two years," but the trend of consolidation in life insurance has created an industry in which scale is increasingly important.
